name: NVIDIA Corp
day_summary: NVDA rose +1.37% to $184.90, printing a fresh intraday high near $186 as AI-capex optimism and HBM-supply headlines lifted the complex. Calls paid; the trend stayed firmly with the bulls.

decision.rationale: Trend intact but extended into the ATH and into Friday's jobs report. HOLD core; let it come in before adding — chasing a parabolic move ahead of a macro catalyst is poor risk/reward.

positioning.notable_flow: Call-heavy; upside chasing in weekly $185/$190 strikes.

what_traders_are_doing: Momentum longs pressing the AI leader into new highs; little hedging on a calm tape — complacent positioning the day before a jobs report.

news.label: AI-capex optimism and tight HBM supply lift the semiconductor complex to fresh highs

outlook.short_term: Extended; vulnerable to a macro-driven pullback at Friday's payrolls.

bull_case: Fresh highs on rising AI-capex confidence; trend is up.
HBM supply tightness underscores pricing power.
bear_case: Extended into the ATH right before a jobs report — poor risk/reward to chase.
Complacent, call-heavy positioning leaves room for a shakeout.
